response.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(o.order_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders), 0) AS share FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, share DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 10
